title: Human Resource Intern
description:
About the Role We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic HR Intern to join our HR team. The intern will gain practical exposure to Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Engagement, and HR Documentation across our Group of Companies. This role is ideal for a candidate who is interested in building a career in Human Resources, particularly Recruitment and Talent Acquisition . Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Primary Responsibility Assist the HR team in handling end-to-end recruitment activities . Understand job requirements and assist in preparing and posting Job Descriptions. Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels . Screen resumes based on defined job requirements. Conduct initial candidate calls and collect relevant candidate information. Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and hiring teams. Follow up with candidates regarding interview status, feedback, offers, and joining. Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers. Assist in preparing daily/weekly recruitment MIS . Support bulk hiring, walk-in interviews, campus recruitment, and other hiring activities. Build and maintain a database of potential candidates for future requirements. 2. HR Operations Assist with employee onboarding and joining formalities. Support preparation and maintenance of employee documentation. Assist in maintaining employee records and personnel files. Support attendance and leave-related HR activities. Assist with issuing HR letters and other employee documents. Support the HR team in day-to-day administrative activities. 3. Employee Engagement Assist in organizing employee engagement activities and HR events. Support employee communication and internal HR initiatives. Assist in coordinating training programs and employee activities. Participate in various HR projects and initiatives. 4. HR MIS & Documentation Update recruitment and employee databases regularly. Maintain accurate records of candidate and employee information. Assist in preparing recruitment and HR reports. Ensure proper filing and documentation of HR records. Maintain confidentiality of employee and candidate information. 5. General HR Support Coordinate with employees, candidates, and internal departments as required. Support the HR team in implementing HR processes and initiatives. Assist with other HR-related activities assigned by the reporting manager. Required Skills Good verbal and written communication skills . Basic understanding of HR and recruitment concepts. Good interpersonal and coordination skills. Strong follow-up skills. Good organizational and time-management abilities. Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and MS Office . Willingness to learn recruitment and HR processes. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Positive attitude and professional approach. Educational Qualification Pursuing or recently completed MBA / PGDM / BBA / BBM / B.Com / BA with specialization in Human Resources or a related field. Freshers are encouraged to apply.

Key Skills: Recruitment,Screening,Sourcing,Shortlisting,Resource

title: Team Lead/ AM - HR
description:
About the Role 
 TNQ Tech is looking for a Team Lead / Assistant Manager HR to manage Talent Acquisition, predominantly bulk/volume hiring , while also handling a range of HR activities and managing a small team. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on HR professional with strong recruitment expertise, the ability to manage hiring targets and stakeholders, and experience in handling employee-related HR activities. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Talent Acquisition & Bulk Hiring 
 Lead end-to-end recruitment with a strong focus on bulk and volume hiring for trainee, entry-level and experienced positions. Manage recruitment targets and ensure timely closure of open positions. Develop sourcing strategies through job portals, referrals, agencies, campus hiring, walk-ins and other channels. Build and maintain candidate pipelines for recurring and upcoming requirements. Coordinate interviews, assessments, offer rollouts, negotiations and joining formalities. Track and improve recruitment metrics including TAT, offer-to-join ratio, source effectiveness and ageing positions . Partner with hiring managers and business stakeholders to understand manpower requirements and priorities. Handle candidate engagement and proactively manage offer dropouts and counter-offer situations. 
 Team Management 
 Manage and guide a small team of recruiters/HR professionals . Allocate recruitment requirements and monitor individual/team performance against hiring targets. Mentor team members and support them in sourcing, screening, stakeholder coordination and offer closure. Ensure effective workload distribution and timely delivery of recruitment requirements. 
 Other HR Activities 
 Support onboarding, employee engagement and employee connect initiatives. Handle employee queries and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for resolution. Support attendance, confirmation, performance management and other employee lifecycle activities. Assist in HR reports, dashboards and people-related analytics. Support HR policies, processes, documentation and statutory/compliance-related activities. Participate in HR projects and process-improvement initiatives. Work closely with HRBPs, business managers and other support functions on people-related matters. 
 Candidate Profile 
 6- 10 years of experience in HR/Talent Acquisition , with significant exposure to bulk or volume hiring. Experience managing a small TA/HR team is preferred. Strong stakeholder management and hiring-manager coordination skills. Proven ability to manage multiple recruitment requirements and meet hiring targets within timelines. Good understanding of employee lifecycle and general HR processes. Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills. Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Experience in IT, BPO/KPO, publishing, knowledge services or other volume-hiring environments will be an advantage.

Key Skills: Talent Acquisition,BPO Hiring,End to End Recruitment,Recruitment Management,Recruitment,Acquisition,Hrsd,Hiring
